name: Surviving With My Daughter
source:
The mc and his wife were soldiers of the Nemesis Corporation, when their daughter was born they wanted to put an identification chip "Trexv1" (like the ones pets have today to know who the owner is), the mc's wife kills the doctor,
the organization gives the order to kill her and the mc did not hesitate to defend her,
and escaped with his wife and daughter.
From then on they are persecuted by Nemesis, in a world where there is no government, only the Law of Nemesis.
translation:
主角与妻子曾是复仇女神公司的士兵。女儿出生时，公司想给她植入名为“Trexv1”的身份识别芯片，就像如今用来确认宠物主人的芯片一样。妻子杀死了医生，组织随即下令将她处死。主角毫不犹豫地挺身保护妻子，带着她和女儿一起逃了出去。
此后，他们便遭到复仇女神公司的追杀。在这个世界里，没有政府，只有复仇女神公司的法则。
